# Adviuz

> Adviuz (adviuz.ca) is a Canadian advertising platform by Instad Web Services Ltd. (Saskatoon, SK, roots back to 2014). Businesses buy digital flyer campaigns priced per viewed flyer — the balance only decreases when a flyer is actually viewed — and receive leads with contact details in a dashboard. An add-on called the Conversion Engine answers leads in seconds with AI calls, texts and emails, books appointments, and keeps following up for up to six months, within strict courtesy rules (contact 9 AM-7 PM in the lead's timezone, max 2 touches/day, CASL-compliant opt-outs).

## Pages
- [Home](https://adviuz.ca/): Digital flyer distribution — what it is and how it works
- [Conversion Engine](https://adviuz.ca/ai-conversion-engine.html): The AI follow-up add-on
- [About](https://adviuz.ca/about.html): Company background — 400+ businesses, 480+ campaigns since 2014
- [Book a Demo](https://adviuz.ca/book-demo.html): Free 30-minute live demo booking
- [Contact](https://adviuz.ca/contact.html): Phone +1 647 250 1152, support@adviuz.com, Saskatoon SK

- [Pricing](https://adviuz.ca/pricing.html): Digital flyer packages — 1,000 viewed flyers for $5,000 CAD, 2,500 for $12,500, 5,000 for $25,000; larger campaigns by consultation. Charged only for viewed flyers.
- [Partners](https://adviuz.ca/partners.html): Referral partner programme — 10% commission on a referred client's first order, 5% on recurring orders.
